comments.author: @jesusistheanswer3218
comments.text:
God loves you. We are fearfully and wonderfully made by God (Psalm 139:14). Wearing body/shape revealing worldly clothes with stones, sequins, stones , beads and slits is a sin before God. Wearing transparent sleeveless low cut blouses/boubous exposing our body is a sin. Tattoos on the body is a sin. Women wearing pants is a sin and a man wearing dresses or skirts is a sin(Deuteronomy 22:5). Blouses with rounded edges give a masculine look and should not be worn by women.
Relaxing, dyeing, using attachments, wigs, installation, plaiting our hair is a sin before God. Be careful with what you apply to your hair/body. These products you apply to your hair may contain chemicals that may have devastating effects on your scalp and health in future.
Makeup and jewellery and wearing worldly hairstyles is a sin. Anything that we do to alter ourselves from the original made by God is a sin. We are telling God he did not do a good job on us, his creation and we want to perfect his work. We have been perfectly made by God. God is holy and wants us to be holy and live a modest lifestyle. 

“Whose adorning let it not be that outward  adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;”
‭‭1 Peter‬ ‭3‬:‭3‬ ‭KJV‬ 

And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel. 
Zephania 1:8 KJV 

"Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world. And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.”
1 John‬ ‭2‬:‭15‬-‭17‬ ‭KJV‬‬ 

“What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.”
‭‭1 Corinthians‬ ‭6‬:‭19‬-‭20‬ ‭KJV‬‬ 

God loves you. God loves you unconditionally.God loves everyone. Jesus died for your sins. 
Jesus died for you and I , was buried and rose the third day. There is no salvation without faith in the sacrifice that Jesus Christ made on the cross of Cavalry. What God wants is for us to surrender our lives to him, repent from our sins and develop a close relationship with him. Prepare for the coming of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. The rapture is very close, closer than you think. Don't be left behind. God bless you.
